problem_type: Incomplete restoration of cancelled queued input
symptom: Stopping a run loses follow-up instructions and the attachments on unconsumed desktop messages.
direct_cause: The host reads only AbortResult.steer text; queue projection also discards nomi.input attachment claims.
class_root: The adapter converts queued input into text before the user can restore the complete draft.
entry_points: Queue projection for cancellation and resend
internal_only_reason: Installed pi 0.85.1 AbortResult and runtime/lane.js return both original message arrays; Nomi owns the custom message attachment claims and draft projection.
invariants: Every unconsumed steer and follow-up message returns once as draft data after stop.
Queue projection and abort restoration retain the captured attachment identities without inventing display metadata.
generality_proof: One pure adapter extracts draft text and attachment claims from the original pi messages for both cancellation paths.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project persisted input into restorable draft data.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both public AbortResult message arrays use the shared input adapter.
Queue cancellation receives the same captured attachment identities.

recurrence.reason: Every queued follow-up or attachment-bearing desktop input can lose the same data.
same_class_scan: Inspected pi AbortResult and requestOperationAbort queue removal.
Traced Host inputMessage, abort, projectQueues and panel stop/cancel restoration.

prevention.invariant: Unconsumed input is projected as draft data before either cancellation consumer sees it.
prevention.failure_mode: Absent text stays empty; absent attachments stay absent; no fabricated content or authorization is returned.
prevention.strategy: Keep the pi-owned message arrays and share the pure application projection.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old textOfMessage abort adapter is deleted from this modified file; no alternate outcome representation remains.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported pi version retaining original messages in both abort result queues.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Pi already preserves the required input; the application adapter discarded it.
exit_criteria: Run real queue/abort restoration fixtures before adopting any changed AbortResult contract.

migration: No stored format changes; persisted nomi.input attachment claims are projected directly.
residual_risks: Display references and composer chip restoration remain desktop boundary responsibilities, validated by the parent task.

invariant_owner_layer.why: This pure custom-message adapter is shared by queue display and cancelled-input restoration.
